DEFINE
    MEASURE 'Sales'[Total Sales] =
        SUM ( 'Sales'[Amount] )

    MEASURE 'Sales'[Total Sales Last Ramadan] =
        VAR _RamadanDays =
            FILTER (
                SUMMARIZE ( 'Calendar', 'Calendar'[Hijri Year], 'Calendar'[Ramadan Day] ),
                NOT ISBLANK ( 'Calendar'[Ramadan Day] )
            )
        VAR _SameDaysLastYear =
            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                _RamadanDays,
                "Hijri Year", 'Calendar'[Hijri Year] - 1,
                "Ramadan Day", 'Calendar'[Ramadan Day]
            )
        RETURN
            CALCULATE (
                [Total Sales],
                REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ),
                TREATAS ( _SameDaysLastYear, 'Calendar'[Hijri Year], 'Calendar'[Ramadan Day] )
            )

    MEASURE 'Sales'[Total Sales vs Last Ramadan %] =
        VAR _ThisRamadan = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], KEEPFILTERS ( 'Calendar'[Is Ramadan] = TRUE () ) )
        VAR _LastRamadan = [Total Sales Last Ramadan]
        RETURN
            DIVIDE ( _ThisRamadan - _LastRamadan, _LastRamadan )

    MEASURE 'Sales'[Total Sales Eid al-Fitr Window] =
        VAR _DaysBefore = 7
        VAR _EidDays = 3
        VAR _Eids =
            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                FILTER ( 'Calendar', 'Calendar'[Hijri Month Number] = 10 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Day] = 1 ),
                "@Eid", 'Calendar'[Date]
            )
        VAR _Window =
            FILTER (
                ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date] ),
                VAR _Day = 'Calendar'[Date]
                RETURN
                    NOT ISEMPTY (
                        FILTER ( _Eids, _Day >= [@Eid] - _DaysBefore && _Day <= [@Eid] + _EidDays - 1 )
                    )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISEMPTY ( _Eids ),
                CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), _Window )
            )

        VAR _DaysBefore = 7
        VAR _EidDays = 3

            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                FILTER ( 'Calendar', 'Calendar'[Hijri Month Number] = 10 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Day] = 1 ),
                "@Year", 'Calendar'[Hijri Year] - 1
            )

            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                FILTER ( ALL ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Hijri Month Number] = 10 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Day] = 1 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Year] IN _Years ),

                ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date] ),
                VAR _Day = 'Calendar'[Date]

                        FILTER ( _Eids, _Day >= [@Eid] - _DaysBefore && _Day <= [@Eid] + _EidDays - 1 )

                CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Calendar' ), _Window )

            )
        VAR _Eids =
            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                FILTER ( ALL ( 'Calendar' ), 'Calendar'[Hijri Month Number] = 12 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Day] = 10 && 'Calendar'[Hijri Year] IN _Years ),
                "@Eid", 'Calendar'[Date]
            )
        VAR _Window =
            FILTER (
                ALL ( 'Calendar'[Date] ),
                VAR _Day = 'Calendar'[Date]
                RETURN
                    NOT ISEMPTY (
                        FILTER ( _Eids, _Day >= [@Eid] - _DaysBefore && _Day <= [@Eid] + _EidDays - 1 )
                    )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISEMPTY ( _Years ),

DEFINE

        SUM ( 'Sales Lines'[Amount] )

        VAR _RamadanDays =
            FILTER (
                SUMMARIZE ( 'Gulf''s Calendar', 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Hijri Year], 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Ramadan Day] ),
                NOT ISBLANK ( 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Ramadan Day] )
            )
        VAR _SameDaysLastYear =
            SELECTCOLUMNS (
                _RamadanDays,
                "Hijri Year", 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Hijri Year] - 1,
                "Ramadan Day", 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Ramadan Day]
            )
        RETURN
            CALCULATE (
                [Net ]]Sales],
                REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Gulf''s Calendar' ),
                TREATAS ( _SameDaysLastYear, 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Hijri Year], 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Ramadan Day] )
            )

        VAR _ThisRamadan = CALCULATE ( [Net ]]Sales], KEEPFILTERS ( 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Is Ramadan] = TRUE () ) )

            DIVIDE ( _ThisRamadan - _LastRamadan, _LastRamadan )

            FILTER (
                ALL ( 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Day] ),
                VAR _Day = 'Gulf''s Calendar'[Day]

                    NOT ISEMPTY (
                        FILTER ( _Eids, _Day >= [@Eid] - _DaysBefore && _Day <= [@Eid] + _EidDays - 1 )
                    )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISEMPTY ( _Eids ),
                CALCULATE ( [Net ]]Sales], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Gulf''s Calendar' ), _Window )
            )
